facts.fact: 治疗开场：table 变 Tilt-A-Whirl；先出未成形素材如生奶/棕泥
facts.anchor: my patient body becomes a Tilt-A-Whirl at the county fair

facts.fact: 素材：Tullycraft 变成 sadistic fanfic 怪物、她成肉/corpses（创伤原料）
facts.anchor: I gasp and choke and become many bodies

facts.fact: 她把 chaos 加工成可消化份额（moderate bad into safer form）
facts.anchor: I moderate all that’s bad and ugly into safer form.

facts.fact: 今日最差产量：只完成四个转场镜头就卡住
intrusions 更频繁、带 crimson 色、说无意义碎片（golf ball/septic tank）
facts.anchor: They shimmer with the color of crimson.

facts.fact: 排队时首次细看医院：peeling wallpaper/deranged optometrist alphabet posters/ Everyone decayed
facts.anchor: What if this place is making us worse, not better?

facts.fact: 黄裙女 hum Amazing Grace/pigtails 水果衫/conjunctivitis 女孩——病友群像
facts.anchor: the woman in the yellow dress in front of me and listen to her hum an old hymn

facts.fact: BZZZZ：她离队走近蛋形容器、看到 crimson static 咬穿她节目的边界向外蔓延
facts.anchor: I see pure crimson static, angry and entropic

facts.fact: 黄裙女拐弯消失、Amazing Grace 触发另一次 signal intrusion——Spatulas!
facts.anchor: Spatulas, my mind thinks without meaning to.
